notes.title: Version 0.1.7 is here
notes.notes:
Hi Bootleg Systems players!

During the first week after the launch of the Bootleg Systems Demo on December 1st, the community has been very generous with feedback.

In this first update, you should notice the following changes:

- Faster loading time
- Reduced lag
- Improved framerate in some areas
- Better contrast between level and gameplay elements
- Ability to select language from the Main Menu
- Enhanced running controls while using keyboard
- Last puzzle decreased difficulty

These improvements were possible thanks to the players' generous feedback. If you have not shared your feedback with us yet, you can do so here: www.bootlegsystems.com/pre-alpha-demo/feedback

The next update is planned in one week. Any feedback you share now will be included in the next update if it possible for us to do so.

Thank you for playing Bootleg Systems and helping the dev team make it better, one week at a time!

Cheers,


- The Neonable Team
